svg.title: Figure 6. Price and value by cell type
svg.desc: Figure 6. Two scatter plots, descending and ascending cell types, of neck-crossing wire length (logarithmic) against the flow lost when that wire alone is removed. Most dots lie on zero: 622 of 911 descending and 899 of 1,010 ascending types lose no flow. Rank correlation 0.231 for descending types, 0.044 once the number of connections is controlled for; −0.005 for ascending types.
